metaphor: a long-exposure photograph: they never got a picture, so the page exposes one, and the thing on the plate is time
category_convention_avoided: Every adoption site is white, rounded, photo-led, Nunito/Poppins, teal or orange CTA, paw icons. Unavailable here: none of the 516 dogs has a photograph in the public record.
design_code: Light is the material on a dark ground, because the only record these animals have is the one quantity that accumulates: days waited.
Frame brightness is a blackbody ramp driven by days_waiting, because exposure is literally time on the plate. Pancho at 448 days is the brightest object on the page and that is the whole argument.
Nothing flashes; only the longest waits breathe, on a 9s cycle, because the subject is duration rather than urgency. Alarm coding would misstate what the data says.
anti_brief: No cute register: no paws, bones, rounded friendly type. 516 animals nobody has come for.
No red alarm coding. This is duration, not an emergency dashboard.
No paper, stamps, perforation or monospace record fields. That was the previous pass and it is the barred family.
expressive_axis: luminosity. The exposure gradient across 516 frames is the one loud thing; type, structure and motion are restrained.
canvas_posture: dark is home. Light theme is the print rather than the negative: exposure reads as ink density instead of emitted light.

contrast_verified.note: measured against --frame. ramp_0 carries only the day count, which is 31px/600 or larger and therefore large text at a 3:1 floor.

type.voice: a plate exposed slowly, then read carefully
type.mono: none, deliberately: monospace was the previous pass's tell
type.numerals: tabular everywhere a count appears (.num), because day counts are compared down a column

structure: contact-sheet grid. Frames are numbered 001.. and ordered by exposure, so the sheet reads as one strip rather than a card gallery.

edge_and_depth.radius: 0 throughout; a frame edge is a frame edge
edge_and_depth.depth: emitted. Elevation is a halo and a box-shadow tinted with the frame's own ramp color, never a neutral drop shadow. Glow appears only above 0.55 exposure, so it encodes data rather than decorating.

motion.explains: the sheet developing, in exposure order
motion.signature: frames fade up staggered 22ms in wait order on load; the 7 longest waits breathe their border on a 9s cycle

supersedes.why: disqualified at ledger check. Collided with cooldown on canvas (light-neutral), accent (stamp red hue 13 vs 8), ornament (perforation), type (mono display+body) and depth (flat print), and print-editorial is barred until three non-print projects ship.
